claims.content: Customer browses and searches products using the site’s category browse pages and search result pages.

goal.raw_text: Customer browses and searches products using the site’s category browse pages and search result pages.

claims.content: Customer
Endeca or Endeca-like search and navigation capability MUST be integrated into any platform solution. It must have significant drill-down capability due to the large number of SKUs.

All active auction items must be searchable by all item attributes, including product ID, auction number, product category, product type, stone type, metal type, current price, as well as full text search on the description field.
No product will ever be eligible to appear on a product details page, search results, or catalog page if it does not have an available image to display.
Customer initiates the use case by selecting a category from the Home page Top-level Left Navigation, beginning the Category Browse Pages / Search Result Pages process.

trigger.raw_text: Customer initiates the use case by selecting a category from the Home page Top-level Left Navigation, beginning the Category Browse Pages / Search Result Pages process.

claims.content: Customer selects a category from the Home page Top-level Left Navigation.

System displays the Category 'Browse' Pages / Search Result Pages with global site header & footer, a navigational bread crumb trail at the top of the page, and the Endeca navigation section on the left side of the page in an expanded state.
Customer uses the Endeca or Endeca-like search and navigation capability to search and drill down through additional criteria.
Customer selects a product from the Catalog Pages.
System displays the Product Details (Bidding) page, including the navigational bread crumb trail.

Depending on the user’s initial click action (gemstones, jewelry, watches, jeweler supplies, and collectibles), multiple page templates are used for the Category “Browse” Pages / Search Result Pages; each template will have different title tags and frequently-searched text at the bottom for SEO.
Items that are closed will be removed within 1 minute (or whatever interval).
If a search action returns no matching items, the system displays the 'No Results Search Page' (exit: the use case ends on the No Results Search Page).
The Category “Browse” Pages / Search Result Pages include a global site header & footer and the Endeca navigation section on the left side of the page in an expanded state.
Breadcrumbs appear on the category pages and the product details pages.
If there is only one search match, the product details page should load.
If the search results in multiple items found, a category / search result page should load, using the default catalog view page.
